shortDescription: Uploads a firmware image onto the AOS-CX switch.

options.name: firmware_file_path
options.description: File name and path for locally uploading firmware image

options.name: partition_name
options.description: Name of the partition for the image to be uploaded.

options.name: remote_firmware_file_path
options.description: HTTP server address and path for uploading firmware image, must be reachable through provided vrf.

options.name: vrf
options.description: VRF to be used to contact HTTP server, required if remote_firmware_file_path is provided.

options.name: wait_firmware_upload
options.description: If true, the result will be displayed after the firmware upload process is done. If false, the result must be checked on the switch by the user.
